text:
maria: Heads-up: pausing pre-merge for release/2026-03 until the KMS rotation in acct-9876 finishes. Deploybot preflight flagged a key rotation. Can we coordinate an apply window and provider pin?

deploy-bot: Preflight result: terraform plan blocked by KMS rotation. Resource: module.kms.aws_kms_key.redwood_key (rotation_in_progress=true). Lock acquired by ops-bot. To override: `deploybot override --reason 'emergency'` (NOT recommended).

alex: On it. Running a dry-run plan in staging now. I'll pin provider to a hashed release (provider.aws@v4.27.0-pinned) for the canary apply. ETA ~20m.

sam: Quick question — plan shows changes to aws_iam_role.redwood-infer (assume_role updated). If trust relationship changes we must do a staggered rollout and not touch prod-wide roles in one go.

jin: +1 stagger. My proposal: canary in us-west-2 for 1 hour under tag `release/2026-03-canary`, monitor callouts, then traffic shift if healthy.

deploy-bot: Suggested flow: 1) Wait for KMS rotation complete (deploybot will re-run preflight automatically). 2) `terraform plan -target=module.kms` and review. 3) Apply module.kms first, then full apply. Auto-apply disabled while kms_rotation=true. Docs: https://internal.redwood.io/kms-rotations (internal).

maria: Release-eng — please add a short blurb to release notes indicating the rotation window and that infra cutover may be gated manually. Also include rollback steps.

release-engineering: Will do. Adding: "KMS rotation may delay infra cutover by up to 30m. Manual intervention required if rotation retries >3."

ben: Rollback playbook (brief): 1) Revert TF PR immediately. 2) If state locked, `terraform force-unlock <LOCK_ID>` then re-run plan. 3) If KMS policy corrupted, revert key policy to previous version in the KMS console and notify security.

ben: ```
# minimal commands
git checkout -b revert/infra-kms-fix
git revert <PR_SHA>
terraform init
terraform plan
# if stuck: terraform force-unlock 12345678-90ab-cdef-1234-567890abcdef
```

ops-bot: Maintenance window reserved: 2026-03-21 09:30-10:30 UTC. If apply not complete by 10:20 UTC we will abort and re-open the merge hold. React with :rotating_light: to abort.

alex: Staging plan succeeded w/ pinned provider and no drift. I'll coordinate the canary apply in us-west-2 at ~09:35 UTC and tag the run with `release/2026-03`. I'll post plan output and apply run id here.

jin: I'll watch canary metrics (latency, token-cost, auth errors) and be ready to rollback on anomalies.

maria: Thanks all — holding until alex confirms canary apply started. Ping in-thread if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
